chunks: I asked him about a man who urinates and does not wash his private part until he performs the wudu of salat (prayer). He said: He should wash his private part and not repeat his wudu.
11—Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-'Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from 'Amr ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who urinates and then forgets to wash his private part and performs wudu. He said: He should wash his private part and not repeat his wudu.
ai.seo_question: If someone forgets to wash after urinating and then performs wudu, must the wudu be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity after urination. If a person performs wudu before washing the private part, he must wash the private part afterward, but his wudu remains valid and does not need to be repeated.
